name: Well-Blessed Tokens
status: common in the south, prized by travelers

rarity.note: Genuine hedge-craft: weak, but reliably about the water.

summary: Reed-and-clay tokens blessed at a Well-Sister's dawn drawing, carried by anyone who must drink uncertain water. A genuine token dropped into a questionable source keeps it sweet for a day and shows any poison as an oily sheen. The Sisters make them from each oasis's own clay — a token works best near the well that made it, and hollowborn say they 'long to go home'.
origin: The Well-League; practice predates the Salt Roads
current_whereabouts: Caravan kits continent-wide; genuine ones only from Well-Sisters directly.
properties: Sweetens a day's water and reveals poison as sheen — hedge-craft's most reliable working, because the Sisters practice constantly
Dissolves fully when spent; a used token proves nothing and is worth nothing
Counterfeits abound; real ones smell faintly of the reeds they were fired with
keepers: Well-Sisters distribute; reselling them north is tolerated so long as the price stays honest.
value_or_danger: A shard honest. In the deep dunes during emergency: whatever you have.
adventure_hooks: A token sheens over water everyone has drunk already. The poison is slow, and it is already inside half the caravan.
A Sister blesses tokens for players and refuses payment: 'you'll be carrying something for me instead.'
